page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.2xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 8 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz alongside 64.0 GB of system memory. With an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual CPU, the hardware architecture delivers a 1:8 compute-to-memory distribution suited for memory-intensive enterprise tasks.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The configuration lacks GPU accelerators. Operating with decoupled storage reduces local device dependencies and supports architectures where compute nodes access external storage clusters.

The 1:8 memory-to-vCPU ratio yields qualitative resource efficiency by providing substantial RAM density without necessitating higher vCPU allocations. Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.2xlarge is suitable for in-memory caching platforms, relational databases, enterprise resource planning applications, and ETL batch processing pipelines that require sizable active working memory.

This decoupled storage configuration offers deployment flexibility for stateless architectures and network-backed stateful systems. By pairing moderate multi-core processing with high memory capacity, the server maintains hardware efficiency for memory-constrained environments. The instance is suited for in-memory caching layers, relational database engines, search nodes, enterprise application servers, and intermediate data processing pipelines.
